class.name: BoneClothCollision3D
class.brief_description: A base class of the collisions that interact with [BoneClothSimulator3D].
class.description: A collision has an effect only as a child of [BoneClothSimulator3D]. It pushes out the simulator's joints and links, in scene tree order. If [member bone] is set, the collision follows the bone's pose with [member position_offset] and [member rotation_offset]. Moving or rotating the collision updates the offsets. The sizes and [member position_offset] are in meters, as the values of [BoneClothSimulator3D] are, and the collision's scale is set to match; a scale set by hand is ignored. Without [member bone], the shape uses the node's own transform, scale included. If [member mirror_bone_name] is also set, the same shape collides a second time on that bone, mirrored from left to right. The mirrored shapes push after all the collisions, in the same order.

method.name: get_skeleton
method.description: Returns the [Skeleton3D] of the parent [BoneClothSimulator3D], or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

members.member: The index of the attached bone. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.
The name of the attached bone.
The index of the mirror bone. [code]-1[/code] is no mirror.

The name of the bone on the other side, such as the right thigh for a collision on the left thigh. The collision also collides on this bone, with [member position_offset] and [member rotation_offset] mirrored across the skeleton's YZ plane in the rest pose. It can be [member bone] itself, which mirrors a shape on one side of a center bone such as the hips. Has no effect when [member bone] is not set.
The position offset from the [member bone] pose, along the bone's axes.
The rotation offset from the [member bone] pose.
